tools.name: check_text
tools.description: Check pasted text or code (up to 16,000 characters) for statements of AI use and named AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot, quoting the exact sentence. For 100+ characters it also returns an AI-likelihood estimate, labelled as an estimate, not proof of authorship. Private: no public

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Fetch a public web page or file and read AI labels, AI-use statements, Content Credentials and saved creation records found there. Logins, paywalls and CAPTCHAs are not bypassed. No public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

tools.name: check_image
tools.description: Check an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or single-page TIFF, up to 20 MiB) by public URL or base64 for C2PA Content Credentials, AI labels, saved generation settings and metadata. Evidence comes from records in the file, not a visual-only verdict. No public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com

tools.name: extract_saved_prompt
tools.description: Read the prompt, negative prompt, model and settings saved inside an image by AUTOMATIC1111, ComfyUI (including Flux workflows), InvokeAI or NovelAI. Only reads records stored in the file; it never reconstructs or guesses a prompt. Screenshots and re-uploads usually remove these records. Docs: https

tools.name: read_content_credentials
tools.description: Read C2PA Content Credentials from an image, video, audio or PDF file (by public URL or base64, up to 20 MiB). Reports the manifest, recorded actions and digital source type, with cryptographic validation and signer trust as separate findings. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

tools.name: estimate_x_ai_replies
tools.description: Estimate what share of the replies under an X (Twitter) post look AI-generated or bot-driven. Pass the reply texts with any author details (handle, bio, followers, following, joined date, default avatar) and timestamps you have; the post text and time sharpen the estimate. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_url, check_image, read_content_credentials · Private data: check_text, check_url, check_image, extract_saved_prompt, read_content_credentials · Public sink: estimate_x_ai_replies · Destructive: extract_saved_prompt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_url, check_image, read_content_credentials · Private data: check_text, check_url, check_image, extract_saved_prompt, read_content_credentials · Public sink: estimate_x_ai_replies · Destructive: extract_saved_prompt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_text" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
